import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        double x = sc.nextDouble();
        double y = sc.nextDouble();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        double diff_min = 1e9;
        long a_num = 0, a_den = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long lcm = gcdLL(y, i);
            long ip = (long)(x * (lcm / y));
            long denom = lcm / i;

            if (ip % denom == 0) {
                ip /= denom;
            } else {
                double val = ip;
                double denom_d = denom;
                val = (val / denom_d) + 0.49;
                ip = (long) val;
            }

            double ip_dbl = ip;
            double current_diff = Math.abs(x / y - ip_dbl / i);
            if (diff_min > current_diff) {
                diff_min = current_diff;
                a_num = ip;
                a_den = i;
            }
        }

        int g = gcdLL(a_num, a_den);
        a_num /= g;
        a_den /= g;

        System.out.println(a_num + "/" + a_den);
        sc.close();
    }

    private static long gcdLL(long a, long b) {
        if (b == 0) return a;
        return gcdLL(b, a % b);
    }
}
